title: A Concavity Inequality for Hessian Quotient Equations
summary: We prove a concavity inequality for the Hessian quotient operator $σ_k/σ_{k-1}$ using a change of basis for symmetric polynomials. This removes an additional structural concavity assumption previously imposed in the interior $C^2$ estimate for convex solutions of the $σ_k/σ_{k-1}$ equation. The method also yields several useful inequalities for elementary symmetric polynomials.
